mapper.sql: WHERE H.HOUSE_STTS_CD = 'ACTIVE' AND H.DEL_YN = 'N' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PRTNR_MST P JOIN USER_ACNT U ON U.USER_SN = P.USER_SN WHERE P.PRTNR_SN = H.PRTNR_SN AND P.DEL_YN = 'N' AND P.APRV_STTS = 'APPROVED' AND U.ACNT_STTS = 'ACTIVE')

sql.if: AND (H.HOUSE_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '\\' OR H.ADDR LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '\\')

mapper.select:
SELECT H.HOUSE_SN, H.HOUSE_NM, SIDO.REGION_NM AS SIDO_NM, SIGUNGU.REGION_NM AS SIGUNGU_NM, (SELECT HI.ATCH_FILE_SN FROM HOUSE_IMAGE HI WHERE HI.HOUSE_SN = H.HOUSE_SN AND HI.DEL_YN = 'N' AND HI.RPRS_YN = 'Y' LIMIT 1) AS RPRS_ATCH_FILE_SN, (SELECT MIN(R.BSC_PRSN_CNT) FROM ROOM R WHERE R.HOUSE_SN = H.HOUSE_SN AND R.DEL_YN = 'N' AND R.ROOM_STTS_CD = 'ACTIVE') AS BSC_PRSN_CNT, (SELECT MAX(R.MAX_PRSN_CNT) FROM ROOM R WHERE R.HOUSE_SN = H.HOUSE_SN AND R.DEL_YN = 'N' AND R.ROOM_STTS_CD = 'ACTIVE') AS MAX_PRSN_CNT FROM HOUSE H LEFT JOIN REGION SIDO ON SIDO.REGION_CD = H.SIDO_REGION_CD LEFT JOIN REGION SIGUNGU ON SIGUNGU.REGION_CD = H.SIGUNGU_REGION_CD
ORDER BY H.HOUSE_SN DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT H.HOUSE_SN, H.HOUSE_NM, H.ADDR, H.HOUSE_DC, H.ADULT_ADD_CHRG_AMT, H.CHILD_ADD_CHRG_AMT, H.INFANT_ADD_CHRG_AMT, H.CHKIN_TIME, H.CHKOUT_TIME, H.LATE_CHKOUT_TIME, H.RSVT_CNFIRM_CD, H.CNCL_RFND_PLCY_CN, H.PBTRNSP_GUIDE_CN, H.NOTICE_CN, SIDO.REGION_NM AS SIDO_NM, SIGUNGU.REGION_NM AS SIGUNGU_NM, PM.CONM, PM.RPRSV_NM, PM.BRNO, PM.MAIL_ORDER_SALES_NO FROM HOUSE H JOIN PRTNR_MST PM ON PM.PRTNR_SN = H.PRTNR_SN LEFT JOIN REGION SIDO ON SIDO.REGION_CD = H.SIDO_REGION_CD LEFT JOIN REGION SIGUNGU ON SIGUNGU.REGION_CD = H.SIGUNGU_REGION_CD
AND H.HOUSE_SN = #{houseSn}

SELECT R.ROOM_SN, R.ROOM_NM, R.BSC_PRSN_CNT, R.MAX_PRSN_CNT, R.MIN_STAY_NGT_CNT, R.ROOM_DC, R.AREA_SQM, R.ROOM_CNT, R.BATHRM_CNT, (SELECT RI.ATCH_FILE_SN FROM ROOM_IMAGE RI WHERE RI.ROOM_SN = R.ROOM_SN AND RI.DEL_YN = 'N' AND RI.RPRS_YN = 'Y' LIMIT 1) AS RPRS_ATCH_FILE_SN FROM ROOM R WHERE R.HOUSE_SN = #{houseSn} AND R.ROOM_STTS_CD = 'ACTIVE' AND R.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY R.ROOM_SN
